description: Record a remote signature for one signer of an agreement, identified by the token in their personal signing link. Public: the token is the only credential. The signature is refused with 400 unless the signing audit trail already shows this signer was presented this exact agreement text, which happens when they open it through the get-agreement route. It also writes a signer.signed entry to that trail with IP, country, user agent and a hash of the signature image, stores the signature, and fires the per-signature automation trigger. When this signature completes the envelope under its completion policy, the completion pipeline runs exactly once (audit entry, verification token, completion workflow, admin notification, completion automation and confirmation email). The signer is also emailed a receipt with a verification link, except when their signature completed the envelope and they are the envelope's client, who gets the completion email instead. A signer who declined or whose request expired gets 409, and an unknown token gets 404. Repeating the call for a signer who already signed does not change the stored signature, but it can still append another audit entry and resend the receipt.

description: Submit a public online booking for a company, identified by its slug in the body. Public and rate-limited: no sign-in is needed. Where the deployment enforces the bot challenge, a valid turnstileToken is required (403 otherwise), and a submission from an embedded widget (?embed=1) must come from an origin on the company's widget allowlist. The booking is refused with 409 when online booking is not set up or open, no inspector serves the area, or the requested date and window have no free slot; a named inspector who is unavailable is refused rather than replaced. On success it creates an inspection request holding one inspection per selected service (or a single inspection when no services are sent), in the requested state and unpaid, assigned to the chosen or auto-selected inspector, and consumes any new-inspection quota. It then records the client and any referring agent, snapshots the deposit owed, emails the client a confirmation, pushes the appointment to the inspector's connected calendar, and fires the booking-received automation; the last three happen after the response is sent. The response gives the inspection and request ids and depositRequiredCents (integer cents, 0 when none). Not idempotent: each call creates another booking.
